pitch:
# A kanban board for a small team

## 1. People and their journey

**Team member** (the only role). Every member has the same abilities.
- Needs to see: what work exists, which column each card is in, who holds it.
- Decides: what to create, who does it, when it moves.
- Path: open the board, scan the columns, add or open a card, assign it, drag it onward as work progresses, until it sits in the last column.

## 2. How it looks

A kanban board as people know it from Trello: a pale page with a horizontal row of tall, rounded grey column lanes, each holding a vertical stack of white cards.

- **Page background**: flat soft blue-grey (#E8EDF2), filling the window behind everything.
- **Top bar**: flat dark navy strip across the top, with the board name in white and the member avatar chips at the right.
- **Member chips**: small round coloured circles with white initials. Each member has a distinct colour: blue, green, orange, purple, teal, red. A chip is outlined white when it is the active filter.
- **Column row**: sits below the bar and scrolls sideways when columns overflow.
- **Column**: flat light grey (#DDE2E8) rounded lane with a title and a card count. While a card is dragged over it, it turns light blue.
- **Column menu**: a "⋯" button in the column header. Hovering darkens its background.
- **Card**: raised white rectangle with a faint shadow, showing the title and the assignee chip at the bottom right. Hover deepens the shadow. While dragged it tilts slightly with a larger shadow. A dashed grey gap marks its drop spot.
- **Unassigned card**: shows a dashed empty circle instead of a chip.
- **Add card button**: text button at the bottom of each column. While open it becomes a text box with "Add" and "Cancel".
- **Add column**: a translucent lane at the row's right end reading "+ Add column"; it turns into a name box when clicked.
- **Card dialog**: a white raised panel centred over a dimmed backdrop, with title field, description field, assignee picker, Delete (red text) and Close.
- **Delete confirmation**: a small dialog with a red "Delete" button and a grey "Cancel".
- **Empty column**: shows a faint dashed outline where cards would go.

## 3. How it is used

- Click "Add card" in a column, type a title, press Enter or click Add: the card goes to the bottom.
- Press Escape or click Cancel while adding: nothing is created.
- Click a card: the card dialog opens.
- Edit the title or description in the dialog: changes save when the field loses focus.
- Choose a member in the assignee picker: the card shows their chip. Choose "Unassigned" to clear it.
- Drag a card with the mouse to a spot in any column: it moves there.
- Touch: long press a card, then drag it to a new spot.
- Click "+ Add column", type a name, press Enter: the column is added at the right end.
- Click a column title: it becomes editable; Enter saves.
- Drag a column header sideways: the column changes place.
- Open the column menu and choose Delete: a confirmation appears.
- Click a member chip in the top bar: only that member's cards show. Click it again to clear.
- Click the backdrop or Close, or press Escape: the dialog closes.

## 4. Scope

One board for the team. Members create, edit, assign, filter and move cards across ordered columns, and manage the columns. Not included: outside access, billing, reports, integrations.

## 5. Things and their states

- **Board**: a name and an ordered list of columns.
- **Column**: a name, a position, and an ordered list of cards. It is either present or deleted.
- **Card**: a title, a description, at most one assignee, a column and a position. It is unassigned or assigned, and it is either present or deleted.
- **Member**: a name, a colour and initials.

## 6. Rules

- A card title is required; an empty title is refused and the card is not created.
- A title is at most 120 characters; extra typing is ignored.
- A card is in exactly one column at one position.
- A card has at most one assignee, who must be a team member.
- Dropping a card outside any column returns it to its original spot.
- Moving a card reorders the other cards without gaps.
- Column names are required and unique; an empty or duplicate name is refused and the old name stays.
- Deleting a column that has cards is refused until the cards are moved or deleted; the confirmation says so.
- The last remaining column cannot be deleted.
- Deleting a card needs confirmation; Cancel changes nothing.
- The member filter only hides cards; it never changes them.
- Every member can edit any card.
- The board remembers card positions and column order after reload.
domain_name: A kanban board for a small team
entities_block:
- **Board** (created by audience): [id: string, name: string, columns: list of Column {id: string, name: string, position: int, is_deleted: boolean}, members: list of Member {id: string, name: string, colour: string, initials: string}]
- **Card** (created by audience): [id: string, title: string, description: string, position: int, is_deleted: boolean, member_id: string]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Card title is required] (Board): Given a column is open for adding a card When the member submits an empty title Then the card is not created and no card is added to the column
- [Card title length limit] (Board): Given a card title already holds 120 characters When the member types further characters Then the extra characters are ignored and the title stays at 120 characters
- [Card creation appends to bottom] (Board): Given a column with existing cards When the member adds a card with a valid title Then the new card is placed at the last position of the column
- [Cancel adding creates nothing] (Board): Given the member is adding a card with a typed title When the member presses Escape or clicks Cancel Then no card is created in the column
- [Card description and title edits save on blur] (Board): Given a card dialog is open with an edited title or description When the field loses focus Then the change is saved to the card
- [Card edit refuses empty title] (Board): Given a card has a title When the member clears the title and it loses focus Then the empty title is refused and the previous title remains
- [Assign a team member to a card] (Board): Given a card and a team member of the board When the member chooses that member in the assignee picker Then the card's assignee is set to that member
- [Reject assignee outside team] (Board): Given a card and an id that is not a team member of the board When assignment is attempted Then the assignment is refused and the card's assignee is unchanged
- [Unassign a card] (Board): Given a card assigned to a member When the member chooses Unassigned Then the card has no assignee
- [Move card to a column position] (Board): Given a card in a column When the member drops it at a spot in another column Then the card is in the target column at that position and in no other column
- [Moving a card reorders others without gaps] (Board): Given a board with several cards in columns When a card is moved to another position Then the remaining cards in both columns have contiguous positions starting at 1 with no gaps
- [Drop outside any column reverts card] (Board): Given a card being dragged from its original spot When the card is dropped outside any column Then the card returns to its original column and position
- [Touch long press starts card move] (Board): Given a card on a touch device When the member long-presses the card and drags it to a new spot Then the card moves to that spot
- [Column name is required] (Board): Given a column with a name When the member saves an empty name Then the name is refused and the previous name remains
- [Column name is unique] (Board): Given another column already named X When the member names a column X Then the name is refused and the previous name remains
- [Add column at right end] (Board): Given a board with ordered columns When the member adds a column named with a unique non-empty name Then the column is appended at the last position
- [Reorder columns by drag] (Board): Given a board with ordered columns When the member drags a column to another place Then the column takes the new position and the other columns keep their relative order
- [Delete column with cards is refused] (Board): Given a column containing one or more cards When the member confirms deletion of the column Then the deletion is refused and the column and its cards remain
- [Delete empty column] (Board): Given an empty column that is not the last column When the member confirms deletion Then the column is marked deleted and remaining columns keep contiguous positions
- [Last column cannot be deleted] (Board): Given a board with exactly one column When the member deletes that column Then the deletion is refused and the column remains
- [Delete card requires confirmation] (Board): Given a card delete is requested When the member chooses Cancel in the confirmation Then the card remains unchanged in its column
- [Confirmed card deletion] (Board): Given a card delete is requested When the member confirms with Delete Then the card is marked deleted and the remaining cards in its column have contiguous positions
- [Member filter only hides cards] (Board): Given a board with cards assigned to several members When the member clicks a member chip in the top bar Then only cards assigned to that member are shown and no card attribute changes
- [Clear member filter] (Board): Given the member filter is active for a member When the member clicks that chip again Then all cards are shown again
- [Every member can edit any card] (Board): Given two members of the same board When one member edits a card created by the other Then the edit is permitted and saved
- [Board persists card positions and column order] (Board): Given a board with ordered columns and positioned cards When the board is reloaded Then columns and cards appear in the same order and positions as before
- [Card dialog closes on backdrop, Close or Escape] (Board): Given the card dialog is open When the member clicks the backdrop, clicks Close, or presses Escape Then the dialog closes
- [Column menu layout and hover] (Board): Given a column header is displayed When the member hovers the menu button Then its background darkens
- [Drop target highlight] (Board): Given a card is being dragged When the pointer is over a column Then the column is shown in light blue
- [Unassigned card visual] (Board): Given a card with no assignee When the board is displayed Then the card shows a dashed empty circle in place of a chip
- [Empty column placeholder] (Board): Given a column has no cards When the board is displayed Then a faint dashed outline is shown in the column
- [Active member chip outline] (Board): Given a member chip is the active filter When the board is displayed Then the chip shows a white outline
intent_block:
- Product type: internal_tool
- Audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
- Goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
- Scope: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
- The model must cover: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages); cards representing work items, with title and description; team members and card assignment; card position and movement between columns
- Do NOT model: customer or external user access; billing or subscription management; reporting or analytics dashboards; integrations with other tools
